user.title: New RainCast controller
user.description:
RainCast waters your zones one valve after another, at a daily start before sunrise or at a fixed time. Each zone has its own interval; zones open to the sky are held when the soil is wet or rain is coming.

No valve is opened until you turn on **Valve control**. Until then RainCast only sends the day's plan, so you can compare it with your current setup first.

weather.title: Weather and water
weather.description: All inputs are optional. Without the rain forecast or the outdoor temperature, or while they have no value, they hold nothing. Soil moisture is set per zone.

data_description.rain_sensor: Sensor in mm for the coming day. Zones open to the sky are held while it is above the rain limit.
data_description.water_meter: Total water sensor, in m³ or L. RainCast meters every valve run, finds valves open without water and closes a valve whose flow is above its limit. A meter shared with the house also counts water used there meanwhile.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: No zone is watered while it is below the frost limit, so water does not freeze in pipes and heads.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: A zone is watered as one unit: its valves run one after another, each for its own time. The interval and the valve times can be changed later on the zone's device page.

data_description.valves: Valve, switch or input boolean entities, in the order they run.
data_description.roofed: A greenhouse or a covered bed does not get rain, so the rain forecast does not hold it.
data_description.duration: Starting value for every valve of the zone.
data_description.soil_sensor: Optional, sensor or input number in %. A zone without one does not look at the soil. The limit is set per zone.

reconfigure.title: Weather and water
reconfigure.description: Change the weather inputs and the water meter. Limits and start times are changed on the device page.

reconfigure.title: Edit zone
reconfigure.description: The interval and the valve times are changed on the zone's device page. A valve added here starts with the zone's starting time.

data_description.soil_sensor: Optional, sensor or input number in %. A zone without one does not look at the soil. The limit is set per zone.

data_description.notify_service: Receives the day's plan, the end of every run and problems, for example mobile_app_phone. Leave empty for no notifications.

valve_unavailable.title: {name}: valve unavailable
valve_unavailable.description: {unavailable} has been unavailable for 30 minutes. Zones with this valve cannot be watered. Check the valve controller and its connection.

valve_not_opened.title: {name}: valve did not open
valve_not_opened.description: {not_opened} did not report open within a minute of the start command, so the zone was not counted as watered. The issue clears once the valve opens in a later run.

valve_not_closed.title: {name}: valve still open
valve_not_closed.description: {left_open} still reports open after the stop command. Check the valve; water may be running.

weather_lost.title: {name}: weather data lost
weather_lost.description: {weather} has had no value for an hour. Watering goes on without the holds it gives until it returns.

no_flow.title: {name}: no water through the valve
no_flow.description: {no_flow} reported open, but the water meter did not move for 2 minutes. Check the main valve and the water pressure. The time did not count as watering; the issue clears once the valve runs with water.

flow_high.title: {name}: flow too high
flow_high.description: {flow_high} was closed: its mean flow was above the limit set for it. Check for a broken pipe or sprinkler. The issue clears once the valve runs within its limit.
